about: What the fire alarm's sequence of operations calls for (Q6647): each output of its matrix (or of a written sequence) and each schedule note tying equipment to the fire alarm needs a device or relay that performs it, and its power, on the drawings. Rules data, never job values: the words a page, an output, a mark and a tie are read by, each output class's objects and devices, and the code behind it.

module.name: fire alarm addressable control (relay) module
module.source: trade practice: one addressable control (relay) module beside each unit the fire alarm controls, on the signaling line circuit (NFPA 72 21.2.4, 21.3, 21.7)

outputs.name: shunt trip of the elevator's power
outputs.basis: NEC 620.51(B) and ASME A17.1 2.8.3.3: where sprinklers protect the hoistway or machine room, the elevator's main line is disconnected by a shunt trip ahead of water; NFPA 72 21.4: the fire alarm trips it, and its control power is monitored for integrity (21.4.4)
outputs.ask: Which breaker or switch shunt-trips the elevator's power, and which circuit gives its control power?
outputs.proposal: a shunt-trip breaker on the elevator's feeder (a shunt-trip fused switch is the alternative) with 120 V control power the fire alarm monitors, tripped by a fire alarm control relay set beside it

outputs.name: elevator recall
outputs.basis: NFPA 72 21.3 and ASME A17.1 2.27.3: the fire alarm recalls the elevators by relays at the elevator controller (primary and alternate recall, flashing hat)
outputs.ask: Which relays at the elevator controller recall the cars?
outputs.proposal: fire alarm control relays at the elevator controller (primary recall, alternate recall, flashing hat)

outputs.name: damper release
outputs.basis: NFPA 72 21.7 and IMC 607.3.3.2: the fire alarm closes each smoke and combination damper through a relay that drops its actuator's power
outputs.ask: Which relay drops each damper's actuator circuit?
outputs.proposal: one fire alarm control relay per damper (or one relay dropping the dampers' circuit), set beside it

outputs.name: door release
outputs.basis: NFPA 72 21.8 and IBC 716.2.6.6: the fire alarm releases the door holders through a relay (or by dropping their supply)
outputs.ask: Which relay or supply releases the door holders?
outputs.proposal: a fire alarm control relay dropping the door holders' 24 V supply

outputs.name: fan shutdown or start
outputs.basis: NFPA 72 21.7 and IMC 606.2: the fire alarm stops (or starts, for smoke control) each unit it controls through a relay in the unit's control circuit
outputs.ask: Which relay in each unit's control circuit does the fire alarm drive?
outputs.proposal: one fire alarm control relay per unit, wired into its control circuit, set beside it

outputs.name: equipment interlocked with the fire alarm
outputs.basis: NFPA 72 21.2.4 and 21.3: equipment the fire alarm controls is driven by a fire alarm control relay within 3 ft of the controlled circuit
outputs.ask: Which relay ties each unit to the fire alarm?
outputs.proposal: one fire alarm control relay per unit, within 3 ft of its control circuit

actuator_load.basis: NEC 220.14(A) and 408.4(A): a branch circuit's schedule row carries the loads on it; a circuit feeding N damper actuators carries their N loads
actuator_load.ask: What load do the dampers' actuators put on the circuit?
